# sts (sts.origincloudapis.eu)

Guide: <https://docs.origincloud.eu/docs/iam/workload-identity-federation/index.html.md>

- **SecurityTokenService**: The security token service: it turns a token from an identity provider outside Origin Cloud, such as a CI job's OIDC token, into the access token of a `WORKLOAD` service account that trusts it through a federated credential.

origincloudhq/origincloud 0.18.0 has no resource or data source of this service.

## Other actions

These methods aren't a resource's create, read, update or delete. Where an argument of a resource above sets the same thing (a resource's `protected`, say), change the argument; otherwise the provider doesn't manage the action: run it with the CLI, outside of Terraform, when the user asks for it.

- `AssumeServiceAccount` (`origin sts assume-service-account`): Assumes a `WORKLOAD` service account with an OIDC token.
